programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Avalanche visit the Stars for Game 1 of their first-round series. Dallas ended the regular season on a seven-game slide. Colorado's Nathan MacKinnon shared the NHL lead with 84 assists. The Stars eliminated the Avs in the West semifinals in 2024.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The injury-depleted Stars try to tie up their first-round series with the Avalanche entering Game 2. Without key players Jason Robertson and Miro Heiskanen, Dallas couldn't stop Colorado's attack in Game 1, falling 5-1. Nathan MacKinnon scored twice.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The rejuvenated Stars visit the Avalanche for Game 3 of their West quarterfinal. Dallas evened the series 1-1 with a 4-3 victory in Game 2 on Colin Blackwell's goal at 17:46 of overtime. Nathan MacKinnon (COL) has tallied three times this series.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Stars visit the Avalanche for Game 4 of a West quarterfinal. Colorado's Gabriel Landeskog played for the first time since June 26, 2022, but Dallas spoiled the party on Tyler Seguin's goal at 5:31 of overtime in Game 3 to take a 2-1 series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: Gabriel Landeskog's Avalanche visit the Stars for a pivotal Game 5 of their Western Conference quarterfinal. Landeskog recorded a goal and an assist, and Mackenzie Blackwood made 23 saves as Colorado evened the series with a 4-0 victory in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Avalanche try to stay alive as they return to the Rockies for Game 6 of their West first-round set with the Stars. Wyatt Johnston scored nine seconds into Game 5, finishing with two goals and an assist as Dallas rolled to a 6-2 decision.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Avalanche visit the Stars for Game 7 of their West quarterfinal series. Colorado forced a deciding showdown with a 7-4 victory in Game 6 behind Nathan MacKinnon's go-ahead goal in the third period. Dallas coach Peter DeBoer is 8-0 in Game 7s.

programme.sub-title: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs and Senators engage in another Battle of Ontario in Game 1 of an East first-round set. This is just the third time both have made the playoffs simultaneously since four meetings in five postseasons from 2000-2004, all won by Toronto.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs host the Senators for Game 2 of their Eastern Conference quarterfinal. Mitch Marner had three points and Anthony Stolarz collected his first postseason victory as Toronto took a 1-0 series lead with a 6-2 decision in Game 1.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs try to put a stranglehold on their East first-round series with the Senators in Game 3. Max Domi ripped the overtime winner just over three minutes into the first extra frame of Game 2 to give Toronto a 3-2 win, and a 2-0 series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs look to swiftly end the Senators' playoff return, up 3-0 in Game 4 of their first-round set. Simon Benoit, who scored six goals in his first 288 NHL games, slapped home the overtime winner in Toronto's 3-2 Game 3 victory over Ottawa.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Senators try to continue their comeback in Game 5 of their first-round set with the Maple Leafs. Jake Sanderson saved Ottawa's season and prevented a third straight overtime loss when the defenseman scored in a 4-3 win over Toronto in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Senators continue a comeback attempt as they host the Maple Leafs in Game 6 of an East quarterfinal. Linus Ullmark made 29 saves as Ottawa blanked Toronto 4-0 in Game 5 to stay alive. Tim Stützle notched a goal and two assists for the Sens.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors insight into the world's second-biggest economy, delivering in-depth discussions with newsmakers.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa, linking the market drivers from overnight in the U.S. and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep-dive analysis of the top businesses.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
programme.desc: From London, essential morning viewing to stay ahead of the day's market trends with news stories from the U.S. and Asia in the lead-up to the opening of European markets.
